tools.name: curade_polymarket_odds
tools.description: Normalized Polymarket odds snapshot: volume-ranked rows with question, YES/NO probability, implied probability, 24h volume and liquidity. Use when an agent needs current prediction-market pricing: check whether a market moved after news, rank the busiest markets, or scan for a specific question. Ref

tools.name: curade_polymarket_disagreement
tools.description: Cross-venue disagreement for prediction markets: Polymarket vs Kalshi implied probabilities for matched questions, per-pair gap and the max disagreement. Use when an agent needs a second opinion on a market's pricing before acting on a Polymarket signal, or to detect cross-venue mispricings. Refresh

tools.name: curade_polymarket_package
tools.description: One-time purchase, keep the data: full attested Polymarket data package for ONE market (all snapshot rows, provenance and a signed license token). Use when an agent needs the complete record for one market rather than a live snapshot, e.g. for backtesting or an audit trail. Source: Polymarket public

tools.name: curade_hyperliquid_funding
tools.description: Latest Hyperliquid perpetual-funding snapshot (up to 100 coins ranked by open interest): hourly funding rate per coin (signed; positive = longs pay shorts) and derived APR. Use when an agent needs current perp funding rates for a carry or basis view. Updated hourly. Source: Hyperliquid public data (
